decisions.source_issue: R31–33/F36–37 use mixed route labels, animal-health references and misleading disease-route examples.
decisions.decision: Use human-health contact, respiratory, fecal-oral, vector and blood/perinatal concepts. Respiratory inhalation and direct deposition follow WHO 2024 terminology. Omit incorrect disease-route pairings and diagnosis-by-card.
decisions.remaining: Qualified IPC reviewer must check examples and local task/PPE protocols.

decisions.source_issue: R34/P54 describe a 20-second wash without separating scrubbing time from the full healthcare procedure.
decisions.decision: Use WHO full healthcare wash 40–60 seconds and handrub 20–30 seconds, including all surfaces and drying. Distinguish non-healthcare community guidance from care delivered in BHS/household settings.
decisions.remaining: Qualified instructor must verify the demonstration, equipment, local infection-specific exceptions and translated checklist before use.

decisions.source_issue: R35 mnemonic includes covering one’s own mouth when another person coughs and handkerchief/spitting language.
decisions.decision: Teach tissue or bent elbow, appropriate disposal, hand hygiene and facility symptom/source-control process. Do not teach covering one’s own mouth as adequate exposure control.
decisions.remaining: Confirm local waiting-area and mask/source-control arrangements with IPC staff.

decisions.source_issue: R36/P58–59 give a two-minute boiling instruction and 25-metre septic setback without sufficient context for every locality.
decisions.decision: Teach safe food, protected storage, sanitation and confirmed local water advice. Do not supply unverified treatment doses/times or engineering guarantees.
decisions.remaining: Local water treatment parameters, product instructions, advisories and sanitary-engineering requirements remain unverified and are excluded from procedures.

decisions.source_issue: R36–37/F35/P60–61 combine a ten-policy list with statements that could be misread as a blanket BHW training exemption.
decisions.decision: Confirm the list against the DOH 2021 primary-care policy section and keep all ten items in the worksheet. Require local role/training confirmation; do not imply reading or attendance authorizes specialist tasks. Use observed process and supply measures.
decisions.remaining: Current local adoption, policy versions, training responsibilities, exposure reporting and any newer national requirements need facility confirmation.

document_locators.doh-ipc-2021: PDF page 24 (printed p8): ten primary-care policies; PDF pages 30–31 (printed p14–15): training; PDF page 38 (printed p22): monitoring. Publication is 2021, not certified as the latest local adoption.
document_locators.who-community: Publication page confirms non-healthcare scope; no community timing prescription was inferred from its overview.
